name: AR_UPD_ERROR_DETAILS
description: AR_UPD_ERROR_DETAILS contains mapping information between the staging table record and its error messages.

columns.name: UPLOAD_ERROR_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the staging and error table mapping record.

columns.name: UPLOAD_OWNER_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Receivables interface table that stores customer import data.

columns.name: UPLOAD_OWNER_TABLE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the staging table record.

columns.name: ERROR_OWNER_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the interface table from which the error message is retrieved.

columns.name: ERROR_OWNER_TABLE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the error table record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.
